name: Castle Hill Classics
blurb: Up the funicular to the palace, then along the hilltop to the church and the bastion.

name: Pest Classics
blurb: Parliament, the memorial on the embankment, the Basilica and the Opera.

name: Jewish Quarter & Ruin Bars
blurb: Two great synagogues by day, ruin bars and courtyards by night.

name: Thermal Baths Day
blurb: Soak in the Art Nouveau Gellért Baths and climb up to the Citadella.

name: Danube Promenade
blurb: Bridge-to-bridge walk along the river, ideal around sunset.

name: Andrássy Avenue to City Park
blurb: From the Opera along the grand boulevard to Heroes' Square, the castle in City Park and a soak at Széchenyi.

name: City Park Museums
blurb: Old masters, new architecture and folk art round Heroes' Square and the park.

name: Museums & Grand Cafés
blurb: Ferenciek tere to the Palace District: a literary café, the National Museum and Lechner's tiled masterpiece.
